verses.note: The Spirit's first appearance in Scripture is at creation, present and active over what is not yet ordered. The Old Testament later speaks of the Spirit giving life (Psalm 104:30), a thread the New Testament picks up when it speaks of the Spirit's work of new creation.

The breath God gave in 2:7 is his to give and to withdraw. Human life depends moment by moment on God's Spirit (Psalm 104:29-30, Job 34:14-15), and this verse is the first time God says he will limit it.
